name: Enterprise Dark
description: Gelap, teknis dan padat untuk tool internal, operasional dan developer.

rules.if: the user works with many resources or records every day
rules.then: persistent side navigation with a workspace or a dense table
rules.why: experts move between resources fast and compare rows

rules.if: a page shows logs, configuration or metadata
rules.then: keep it in a narrower context panel next to the work area
rules.why: it supports the task, it is not the task
